test_continuous_actions: test the BC agent with logp, mse, and peerbc loss functions on continuous action environments
test_discrete_actions: test the BC agent with logp and rcal loss functions on discrete action environments
build_make_networks: build BC networks with MLP or LayerNormMLP for continuous or discrete action spaces
run_BCLearner: run the BCLearner to train a behavior cloning agent using demonstration datasets and SGD steps
review_BCTest: review the BCTest class parameterized test cases for continuous and discrete BC agent training
